\multicolumn{6}{@{}p{\linewidth}@{}}{\footnotesize\raggedright\rule{0pt}{2.5ex}\textit{Notes:} Each series $u$ enters as $u^{(k)}$, its adjusted, transformed and winsorized value averaged over the previous $k$ intervals, and as $\bar a^{(k)}(u)$, the share of those intervals on which it was observed; series with an activity indicator also enter as $\bar\chi^{(k)}(u)$, the share off their mode (the mode and its share of intervals are in the description). $\mathcal K = \{1, 5, 25, 125, 625, 3125\}$ in the closing-interval model and in the intraday model; both models use every group here (Section~\ref{sec:rh_data}). Diurnal adjustment: division by the trailing same-interval mean (mean) or standard deviation (s.d.); $g$: the variance-stabilizing map; the volatility-demand series take $\operatorname{asinh}(u_{t,i} / \kappa_{t,i})$ in place of both (Section~\ref{sec:rh_predictors}). A series is signed if it has any negative value: $\ser{spread_vwstock}{\mathrm{Spread}^{\mathrm{VW}}}$ has a single negative value (2018-11-12 11:00 ET) and so takes $g(v) = v$ and the s.d.\ adjustment, where $\ser{spread_ewstock}{\mathrm{Spread}^{\mathrm{EW}}}$ takes $\log v$ and the mean. Unnormalized and unscaled: without the factors $\sqrt{N_{t,i}} / \RV_{t,i}^{3/2}$ (skewness), $N_{t,i}/3$ (quarticity) and $\pi/2$ (bipower variation).}\\
\endlastfoot
\multicolumn{6}{@{}l}{\textit{Realized moments (7; front-month E-mini, one-minute log-price changes)}} \\
\ser{sumret}{$r$} & Sum of one-minute changes in the log price of the front-month contract, $\serx{sumret}{_{t,i}}{r_{t,i}} = \sum_k r_{t,i,k}$ & E-mini S\&P 500 futures & s.d. & $v$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumret
\ser{sumabsret}{$\mathrm{RAV}$} & Realized absolute variation, $\sum_k |r_{t,i,k}|$ & E-mini S\&P 500 futures & mean & $v$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumabsret
\ser{sumret3}{$\mathrm{RSK}$} & Realized skewness, unnormalized, $\sum_k r_{t,i,k}^3$ & E-mini S\&P 500 futures & s.d. & $v^{1/3}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumret3
\ser{sumret4}{$\mathrm{RQ}$} & Realized quarticity, unscaled, $\sum_k r_{t,i,k}^4$ & E-mini S\&P 500 futures & mean & $\sign(v)\,|v|^{1/4}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumret4
\ser{sumpret2}{$\mathrm{RS}^{+}$} & Positive realized semivariance, $\sum_k r_{t,i,k}^2\,\mathbf{1}\{r_{t,i,k} > 0\}$ & E-mini S\&P 500 futures & mean & $\sqrt{v}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumpret2
\ser{sumbipow}{$\mathrm{BV}$} & Bipower variation, $\ser{sumbipow}{\mathrm{BV}}_{t,i} = \sum_{k \ge 2} |r_{t,i,k}|\,|r_{t,i,k-1}|$ & E-mini S\&P 500 futures & mean & $\sqrt{v}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumbipow
\ser{sumautocov}{$\mathrm{AC}$} & First-order realized autocovariance, $\ser{sumautocov}{\mathrm{AC}}_{t,i} = \sum_{k \ge 2} r_{t,i,k}\, r_{t,i,k-1}$ & E-mini S\&P 500 futures & s.d. & $\sign(v)\,|v|^{1/2}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: sumautocov

\ser{effspread_vwstock}{$\mathrm{EffSpread}^{\mathrm{VW}}$} & Value-weighted effective spread, the mean percent difference between the trade price and the preceding midquote & Constituents & mean & $\sqrt{v}$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: effspread_vwstock
\ser{spread_vwstock}{$\mathrm{Spread}^{\mathrm{VW}}$} & Value-weighted quoted spread, the mean percent difference between the bid and the ask & Constituents & s.d. & $v$ & $u^{(k)}$, $\bar a^{(k)}$ \\  % data field: spread_vwstock
